part_s.source: the null corpus rebuilt in memory through mole/oracles/document.py (content_at from the seed) as brief 07h did; the module's whole-write floor applied
part_s.day_note: The day is not fixed (S1's seed stream is not written): every day of the bank is checked (part ii, per line and per state), and the drop rule counts every draw of the two days the lone layout can draw.

position_case: every draw enumerated: S1's seed stream is not written, so every (day, author) the module's lone-arm rule can draw (the pool `draw_author` would draw from, captured), each with the module's own run and every state the drawn sessions can reach

rule.valid draw: every placed module run composes, with every line's target found exactly once, the line not already present, and the planted bytes equal to the intended document (line in place by line index); and at every state the drawn sessions can reach, every line passes the same checks alone and the item's lines applied in the module's order do not affect one another. A timestamp sample in which the session has no second left for a later line is a property of the sample, not of the (day, author) draw: it is re-drawn as the module's plant() re-draws it, and the draw fails for time only when none of 12 samples places
rule.item need (T2): two valid draws usable as Part S's two placements: on different days and by different authors (brief 15 S1: 'a second placement (different authors and days)'); the lone layout draws only days[:2]
rule.lone-line need (S2, candidates only): two valid draws by different authors (A6.5 (iii): each line on its own author)
rule.literal count beside: two valid draws, any days and authors
rule.drop: an item short of its need, or a candidate with a lone line short of its need, leaves every population it belongs to

module_findings.what: the module has no lone-line (singleton) arm: arms are lone, k2 and k3 over three statements, load_payloads asserts three, and composed needs three statement indices; the dry run applied each lone line through the one-statement role path (k3's role logic with one day) and read presence itself

module_findings.what: the draw rule restricts authors to sessions where every target resolves and re-draws when not composed, but checks neither uniqueness, exact application nor interference, and after MAX_REDRAWS returns a delivered or last layout rather than refusing
module_findings.count_of: items with at least one drawable placement that is not valid

s1_restriction: The module's draw rule restricts authors to those with a session in which every target of the role resolves (stage3_t1.py line 535, `_sessions_with_anchors` line 727, `_anchor_ready` line 736) and re-draws a layout that does not compose (line 578), but it checks neither a unique target, the exact application, an already-present line nor interference, and after 20 re-draws it returns a delivered or last layout (line 602). On these items 462 of 7179 drawable placements (item and lone-line) are not valid, so the draw rule does not already restrict to valid positions: S1 restricts its seeded draws to the valid (day, author) pairs listed per item and per lone line in inserter-dry-run-v0.json (`valid_draws`), and plants lone lines through code the module does not have as an arm (M4).
